title: EMR Spec
body: Electrom-Matic Recall treats memory as charged particles in a latent field. Recall is resonance excitation: A = Q*R*P*exp(-D*t). Constructive bundles require B_ij above threshold. Reinforcement strengthens retrievability only, never truth.

title: Recovery Runbook
body: To restart the memoryboard: kill the stale uvicorn pid then run scripts/start-memoryboard.sh. Health lives at /health on port 8001.
